id./param/scenario/cs/y_010_cs_020.pack|cs_:
"Elder, look, tchi!
  The Hero came, tchi!

"Welcome to Tickington, Hero.
  I am the Tockle Elder, Jorocchi.

"We have been seeking you to fulfill a mission.
  First, please look at the altars around you.

"On each altar is an Adventure Log.
  They record the feats of legendary heroes
  who lived in other worlds.

"The mission given us Tockles is to protect
  these Adventure Logs and pass the true
  heroes' feats to posterity...

"To that end, we Tockles have kept
  the Logs safe in this altar room
  all along.

"...But as you can see, recently someone
  has torn the Adventure Logs
  or painted them black.

"We don't know who did this, but if it
  continues, the true history of the Logs
  will be lost.

"So we ask the Hero to enter the Logs'
  worlds and restore the Adventure Logs
  to their original form.

"To enter the Logs' worlds, one must find the
  Logs' pastwords in the Labyrinth of Time...

"But the Hero cannot enter the Labyrinth,
  so we shall send others in your place.

"These are proud Tockle warriors! They will
  enter the Labyrinth of Time for you
  and gather the Logs' pastwords.

"The Labyrinth of Time is right next to the
  altar room, so you can't miss it.

"...Kurutchi, prepare the usual thing.
  Make sure StreetPass works properly.

"Got it, tchi! I'll do my best
  for the Hero, tchi!

"Now, Hero, I'm counting on you.
  Send the Tockle warriors into the Labyrinth
  and find the Adventure Logs' pastwords!
